name: frostlorn-caress-four-wither-counters
notes: Frostlorn Caress's [Diao Chan Bonus] cost modifier (activationCostModifierAbilities["4tqbok1g9w:0"], GeneratedMacroCode.php ~8183) reduces its printed 5-reserve cost by 3 when IsDiaoChanBonus($player) is true. The starting champion (Spirit of Water) is CardID-patched to Diao Chan, Enchantress (00xbh8oc00, the deck's own level-1 champion) with Subcards patched to keep Spirit of Water (tafqldAGRF) in the lineage so WATER stays unlocked (Diao Chan, Enchantress's own element is NORM) -- ChampionHasInLineage("00xbh8oc00") is then satisfied directly by the champion object's own CardID, so the net cost is 5-3=2. Frostlorn Caress is seeded directly into hand (myHand-7) since the shared wither-batch deck's Main is non-FAST filler only (Dungeon Guide/Fluffy Shopkeep -- Fairy Whispers is FAST and would trigger a recurring Opportunity prompt). Because the deck has zero FAST cards, EffectStackOpportunity's own fallback (OpportunityLogic.php ~1167: QueueEffectStackOpportunityRound finds no playable fast cards for either player and calls ResolveTopOfEffectStack() immediately) resolves the spell the instant the 2nd reserve payment completes -- no PASS actions are needed. cardActivatedAbilities["4tqbok1g9w:0"] (~15648) then offers an MZCHOOSE of ALLY objects on either field (only the opponent's seeded Dungeon Guide, em6eEh9q8y, qualifies as a non-champion object); customDQHandlers["4tqbok1g9w:0:CardActivated-1"] (~32767) calls AddCounters($player, $chosen, "wither", 4) on the chosen target.

rulesClauses: [Diao Chan Bonus] This card costs 3 less to activate.
Put four wither counters on target non-champion object.
